name: Kuji Keiko
source:
She is classmate with the protagonist and is good friends with Sakura and Mayumi.

For some reason, she knows a lot of things.

She sometimes gives advice to the protagonist, who is going through a lot. Whether she does it for her own amusement isn't known.

[spoiler] She is dating the student council president and routinely cheats on him. [/spoiler]

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/authoringheaven/futariha.html]official site[/url]]
